reason: The README clearly describes an agent-facing workspace_symbol tool that queries configured LSP language servers to locate code symbols by name, making project analysis the primary purpose.

summaries.zh: 通过配置的语言服务器按名称搜索工作区中的代码符号，并向智能体返回结构化位置与容器信息。
summaries.en: Searches workspace code symbols by name through configured language servers and returns structured location and container information to the agent.
